parts.t: Neighbourhood guide · City of Chilliwack · East Chilliwack
East Chilliwack is an MLS® sub-area name in the City of Chilliwack. The City doesn’t publish a boundary for it.
The closest official description is the agricultural area covered by the Agricultural Area Plan, Schedule B1 of the Chilliwack 2050 Official Community Plan.

As a rough guide, the area’s main road is Chilliwack Central Road, where the area’s school is addressed, and it sits east of Chilliwack Proper on the Fraser River valley bottom toward Rosedale. That is an orientation, not a City boundary.

Planning, zoning and flood

blocks.text: Planning and flood notes for East Chilliwack

parts.t: Plans, zoning and flood rules can be different for each lot.
Official Community Plan Bylaw 2025, No. 5500 (Chilliwack 2050) was adopted on December 16, 2025.
Schedule B1 of the 2050 plan is the Agricultural Area Plan, which covers the city’s agricultural area, including this area.
Published municipal records list no neighbourhood plan for East Chilliwack separate from the Agricultural Area Plan.
ALR: Published municipal records list no ALR percentage specific to East Chilliwack. City-wide, the City says 67% of Chilliwack’s land (17,322 hectares) is in the Agricultural Land Reserve.

Flood: under the City’s Floodplain Regulation Bylaw 4519, habitable floor space in areas protected by a standard dike must be at or above the applicable Flood Construction Level, plus 0.6 m of freeboard.
The City has an ongoing $30 million program to raise the dyke system to the current provincial elevation, and the East Dyke has been upgraded.
My
Chilliwack zoning guide
covers agricultural and rural zones only. For a home on a city lot, send me the address and I’ll look up the zone.

blocks.text: Before you buy in East Chilliwack

parts.t: Check the ALR first.
Look up the exact parcel on the Agricultural Land Commission map before you plan anything beyond the home.
Check the flood rules for the lot.
Ask the City how the floodplain bylaw applies to the exact address.
Ask what is allowed on and beside the parcel.
The area is covered by the Agricultural Area Plan, so ask the City about farm use and building rules.
Confirm the school catchment.
Catchments are changing in September 2027, so use the SD33 School Locator for the exact address.
Check how you will get around.
Published municipal records list no fixed-route bus service into East Chilliwack’s rural roads, so plan for a car or check BC Transit.
Get a full home inspection.
Check the roof, drainage, furnace, plumbing and wiring.
Where is East Chilliwack?
East Chilliwack is an MLS® sub-area name. The City doesn’t publish a boundary for it.
The closest official description is the agricultural area covered by the Agricultural Area Plan, Schedule B1 of the Chilliwack 2050 Official Community Plan.
Ask me if a specific address is in it.
Which schools serve East Chilliwack?
East Chilliwack Elementary (kindergarten to grade 5) is at 49190 Chilliwack Central Rd.

SD33’s news page says a new east side elementary school opens in September 2027, and the Cheam Elementary catchment will be split between Little Mountain Elementary, Strathcona Elementary and the new school.
Published municipal directories do not list a middle or secondary school in East Chilliwack. Check an exact address with the
SD33 School Locator
How do I get around from East Chilliwack?
Published municipal records list no fixed-route bus service into East Chilliwack’s rural roads on BC Transit’s Chilliwack system pages.
Route 71 Agassiz-Harrison runs along Yale Road East through Rosedale, east of this area, with stops including Yale Rd at Hwy 9 and Rosedale: Yale Rd at McGrath Rd.
Check the
BC Transit Chilliwack page
for changes.
What parks, recreation and library are near East Chilliwack?
Published municipal directories do not list a City park or a City recreation centre in East Chilliwack.
The nearest library is the Chilliwack Library at 45860 First Avenue, in downtown Chilliwack.
What plan covers East Chilliwack?
The Agricultural Area Plan, Schedule B1 of the Chilliwack 2050 Official Community Plan.
Published municipal records list no neighbourhood plan for East Chilliwack separate from it.
Is East Chilliwack in a floodplain?
Under the City’s Floodplain Regulation Bylaw 4519, habitable floor space in areas protected by a standard dike must be at or above the applicable Flood Construction Level, plus 0.6 m of freeboard.
The City has an ongoing $30 million program to raise the dyke system, and the East Dyke has been upgraded.
Ask me or the City about a specific lot.
Is any of East Chilliwack in the ALR, and what are the lots like?
ALR status is set parcel by parcel, so check the exact address on the
Agricultural Land Commission map
. City-wide, 67% of Chilliwack’s land is in the ALR, and the Agricultural Area Plan puts the Fraser River valley bottom at about 14,000 hectares.
